observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with a full mirrored wall, a ballet barre, light-blue walls, string lights and a pale floor. A dancer with long brown hair stands with her back to the camera, facing the mirror; she wears a gray acid-washed denim vest over a black long-sleeve top, black pants and white sneakers. A single pink face mask is visible on her face in the mirror reflection (the mirror image is her reflection, not a second person). The camera framing is fixed and wide throughout.
visible_changes: Frames 1-16: both hands are raised to head/face level, palms forming a shape in front of the face, feet planted wide apart; the body is essentially stationary with only minor sway.
Frames 17-20: one arm extends outward to the side (with motion blur) while the other hand remains near the forehead.
Frames 21-27: the torso rotates/turns to one side; the previously raised arm sweeps down and across the body, the hair swings with the turn, and the vest's hanging fabric shifts.
Frames 28-41: both arms come down to the sides with open hands near the hips; the body settles into a slightly angled stance and continues a small torso lean/sway to the end of the clip.
The reflection reproduces all of these motions in mirror-reversed form; the pink mask remains visible in the reflection throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: The choreography before the opening hand-frame pose and after the final sway is not shown.
Whether the opening hand gesture is the start, middle or end of a larger move cannot be determined from the excerpt.
uncertain_details: The exact shape intended by the hands at the face (e.g. framing vs. heart) is ambiguous.
No camera movement is evident; background pillars and mirror seams stay fixed, so any drift is negligible/uncertain.
